t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. Top left: a small mono uppercase eyebrow, a large light-weight sans headline in sentence case and two tiny bracketed mono tags, one filled navy. Left half: five ruled rows, each with a mono numeral, an uppercase mono name and a short sans note for <CONTENT>; each row's hairline runs right into the image. Right half: one matte white polypropylene skid in an open box frame, soft 3D isometric render, even studio light, translucent pale-blue pipes, cropped by the right edge. Square corners, calm and precise.
signature_idea: Each option row's own rule line runs on into the skid, so the list and the equipment read as one annotated drawing.
strengths: rows-into-render is a clear, buildable idea that ties list to equipment
white PP skid matches the real product material
light headline, mono numbers and limestone ground are on-brand
lots of space; five items read instantly
weaknesses: leader lines land on arbitrary skid points; witness modes have no physical location, so the links mean nothing
uppercase mono names are heavier than the light brand voice
skid is cropped at right and a little generic
no steel-blue accent; pale-blue pipes are the only colour
brand_fit_why: Limestone ground, light headline, mono numerals, square corners and a white PP skid fit well, but the leader lines are decorative rather than meaningful.
